name: helm_get
description: Get details of a Helm release: values, manifest, notes, hooks, or all.

arguments.name: what
arguments.desc: values (default), manifest, notes, hooks, or all

arguments.name: all_values
arguments.desc: For values, include chart defaults, not just user-supplied values

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: Kubernetes context to use (optional, uses current context if not specified)

description: Rollback a Helm release to a previous revision.

arguments.name: cleanup_on_fail
arguments.desc: Delete newly created resources on failure

arguments.name: wait
arguments.desc: Wait until all resources are ready

name: kubectl_explain
description: Explain a Kubernetes resource.

arguments.desc: Resource type to explain (e.g., pods, deployments.spec)

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: Kubernetes context to use (uses current context if not specified)

name: kubectl_generic
description: Execute any kubectl command. Use with caution.

arguments.name: command
arguments.desc: kubectl command to execute (without kubectl prefix)

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: Kubernetes context to use (optional, uses current context if not specified)

name: kubectl_get
description: List or get any Kubernetes resource, including custom resources (kubectl get).

arguments.name: resource_type
arguments.desc: Kind, plural or short name, e.g. pods, deploy, svc, nodes, events, certificates.cert-manager.io

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: A single resource name (omit to list)

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.desc: Namespace (omit for the context default; ignored for cluster-scoped kinds)

arguments.name: output
arguments.desc: table (default), wide, name, yaml or json. Secret values are always redacted

arguments.name: sort_by
arguments.desc: JSONPath to sort by, e.g. .lastTimestamp for events

name: kubectl_logs
description: Get container logs (kubectl logs).

arguments.name: pod_name
arguments.desc: Pod name, or TYPE/NAME such as deployment/web to pick a pod of a workload

arguments.name: tail
arguments.desc: Lines from the end (default 200; -1 for all)

arguments.name: previous
arguments.desc: Logs of the previous, crashed container instance

name: kubectl_patch
description: Patch a Kubernetes resource.

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: Kubernetes context to use (optional, uses current context if not specified)

arguments.desc: Kubernetes context to use (optional, uses current context if not specified)

name: kubectl_scale
description: Scale a deployment, statefulset, replicaset or any scalable resource (kubectl scale).

arguments.name: resource_type
arguments.desc: deployment, statefulset, replicaset, or another kind with a scale subresource

arguments.name: replicas
arguments.desc: Desired replica count (0 stops the workload and needs confirmation in confirm mode)

name: kubectl_top
